panels.description: Months later in a reopened Keel repair shop, a customer brings a damaged purifier casing to the counter. The sign reads MORROW & SONS; five maker names appear below. Leave upper area for the sign lettering.
Alex tests the casing while Ren quotes a repair price; the customer counts credits and agrees. Keep the transaction physical and leave upper space.

Alex hands Tomas a receipt marked medicine advance paid and weekly terms complete. Behind the receipt, a compact dated ledger shows repeated purifier repair work and credited debt payments without inventing a separate total. Keep the receipt and ledger distinct; leave upper space for dialogue.
Alex's public record shows the reduced debt and travel eligible for public review while the shop continues working behind him. Leave upper area for the record.
